rec.name: Competitor Comparison Table with Product-Category Tabs
rec.status: Reference only (example from desktronic.de; build status not stated)

what.text: A homepage section titled "How do we compare?" that compares the brand against competitors in a feature-by-feature table. A pill toggle at the top switches between product categories (Desks / Chairs). The brand column is highlighted with a bordered card and the logo. The two competitor columns are "Brands on Amazon" and "Other brands". Rows cover price, stability, noise level, one-piece desktop, dual motor system, certification, lifting speed, return policy and customer support. Each cell carries a green check or red cross plus a short, humorous benefit statement. The brand column ends with a star rating (4.8) and a "Zum Shop" (Go to shop) CTA button. On mobile, the table is a horizontal layout in which the brand column is visible next to the row labels, and the competitor columns are offscreen/scrollable.

why.text: Shoppers on a paid-traffic landing page are comparing options and wondering why they should choose this brand over cheaper marketplace alternatives. Framing the comparison on the brand's own terms shapes the evaluation criteria (contrast effect). Green checks versus red crosses make the advantage scannable in seconds. The playful copy builds personality and memorability. Concrete proof points (certifications, return policy, rating) reduce perceived risk. The highlighted column and CTA at the bottom of the table convert the persuaded visitor right away.

how.text: Build a custom section with a heading, subheading and a category toggle (tabs/pills). Each tab renders its own table dataset. Use blocks for rows (label + 3 cells: brand, competitor A, competitor B), each cell with a check/cross icon and short text. Highlight the brand column with a border, rounded corners and logo header. Add a rating row (stars + score) and a CTA button linking to the collection of the active tab. Use alternating light row backgrounds for readability. On mobile, make the row-label and brand columns sticky/visible and allow horizontal scrolling for competitor columns, or stack into cards.

items: Category tabs (label + icon) with one table dataset per tab
Column headers (brand logo, competitor A label, competitor B label)
Row blocks: row label, per-column text, per-column check/cross state
Highlight style for the brand column (border color, radius)

dependencies.text: No apps visible. Requires brand logo asset, check/cross icons, and category icons. Rating value can be static or sourced from a reviews app. Optional: JS for tab switching. Competitor claims should be legally reviewed (comparative advertising rules, especially in Germany).

items: Conversion rate and revenue per session on paid landing traffic

images.caption: Desktop: 'How do we compare?' table with Desks/Chairs toggle, highlighted brand column, check/cross cells, rating and CTA
Mobile: row labels next to the highlighted brand column with checks, rating and 'Zum Shop' CTA; competitor columns offscreen
